lines.speaker: Rebel Runner
lines.text: Lord Kelsier's people? Thank the — you have to come. Yeden's gone. He took them. All of them.

lines.speaker: Rebel Runner
lines.text: Out. To the plain below the south wall. He said the garrison was half-asleep and we'd take the gate before dawn.

lines.speaker: Rebel Runner
lines.text: It wasn't asleep. It was waiting.
